questions.question: 2/5 of a number exceeds 2/7 of the same number by 40. Find the number.
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

2/5 × Number – 2/7 × Number = 40

**CALCULATION:**

Let the number be ‘x’

⇒ (2/5)x – (2/7)x = 40

⇒ (4/35)x = 40

⇒ x = (40 × 35)/4 = 350

∴ The number is 350

questions.question: 2/3 of 3/4 of 4/9 of 1/60 of 120 of a number will be what percentage of that number?
Find the value of ‘x’ (such that x > 0) which will satisfy the equation 5x + 5¹⁻x – 6 = 0
questions.solution:
**Laws of Indices:**

1. am × aⁿ = a{m ⁺ ⁿ}

2. am ÷ aⁿ = a{m ⁻ ⁿ}

3. (am )ⁿ = amⁿ

4. (a)⁻m = 1/am

5. (a)m/ⁿ = ⁿ√am

6. (a)⁰ = 1

**Calculoation:**

5x + 5¹⁻x – 6 = 0

⇒ 5x + 5/5x – 6 = 0

Let y = 5x,

⇒ y + 5/y – 6 = 0

⇒ y² – 6y + 5 = 0

⇒ y² – y – 5y + 5 = 0

⇒ y(y – 1) – 5(y – 1) = 0

⇒ (y – 1)(y – 5) = 0

⇒ y = 1, 5

When y = 1, then 5x = 1 = 5⁰, hence, x = 0

When y = 5, then 5x = 5 = 5¹, hence, x = 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 ∵ It is mentioned in question that x > 0 so we will not take the value of x that is equal to zero

**∴ x = 1**

questions.question: A square has a perimeter equal to 24 units. If the length of each side of the square is reduced by 2 units, then find the area (in sq units) of the square.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Perimeter of square = 24 units

**Calculation:**

Side of square = perimeter/4 = 24/4 = 6 units

When the side is reduced, new side = 6 – 2 = 4 units

∴ **Area of square = 4 × 4 = 16 sq. units.**

questions.question: If the two sides of obtuse angled triangle are 8 cm and 15 cm and the third side is x then find the range of x if 15 is the longest side.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The sides a, b and c of an obtuse triangle are related as,

c²/2 < a² + b² < c²

Let a = x, b = 8 cm and c = 15 cm

⇒ 15²/2 < x² + 8² < 15²

⇒ 112.5 < x² + 64 < 225

⇒ 112.5 – 64 < x² < 225 – 64

⇒ 48.5 < x² < 161

⇒ √48.5 < x < √161

∵ √49 = 7, we can write

**∴ 7 < x < √161**

questions.question: If two numbers are 40% and 70% less than the third number respectively, then second number is how much percent less than the first number?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the three numbers be x, y, z

⇒ x = (100 – 40)% of z = 60% of z = 0.6 z

⇒ y = (100 – 70)% of z = 30% of z = 0.3 z

⇒ x/y = 2

⇒ y = x/2 = 50% of x

**∴ The second number is 50% less than the first number**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Ratio of 1st to 2nd no. = (100 - 40) : (100 - 70)

⇒ 60 : 30

⇒ 2 : 1

2nd no. = 1 unit less than 1st one = 1/2 = 50% less

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 248 and their difference is 8. What is the ratio of the two numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum of two numbers = 248

Difference = 8

**Calculation:**

Let the numbers be x and y

Sum = x + y = 248 ----(1)

Difference = x – y = 8 ----(2)

Adding eq. (1) and (2), we get,

⇒ 2x = 248 + 8

⇒ x = 256/2 = 128

⇒ y = 128 – 8 = 120

∴ Ratio of numbers = 120 ∶ 128 = 15 ∶ 16

questions.question: P and Q started a business by investing Rs. 156000 and Rs. 117000 respectively and their time period of investment is same. If P’s share in the profit earned by them is Rs. 12000, then what is the total profit (in Rs) earned by both of them together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Investment made by P = Rs. 156000

Investment made by Q = Rs. 117000

**Concept used:**

If time period of investment is same, then Ratio of their share in total profit = Ratio of their investments

**Calculation:**

Ratio of their share in total profit = Ratio of their investments

⇒ 156000 ∶ 117000 = 4 ∶ 3

Sum of ratios = 4 + 3 = 7

P’s profit = (4/7) of (Total profit)

**∴ Total profit = 12000 × (7/4) = Rs. 21000**

questions.question: The average of 26 numbers is 37. One number is added and the new average becomes 41. What is that new number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 26 numbers = 37

**Calculation:**

Let the new number be ‘x’

Sum of 26 numbers = 26 × 37 = 962

When x is added, sum of 27 numbers = 27 × 41 = 1107

⇒ 962 + x = 1107

⇒ x = 1107 – 962 = 145

∴ **The new number is 145**

questions.question: The simple interest on a sum of money is 9/49 of the principal. The number of years are equal to the rate of interest per annum. What is the rate (in percentage) of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

S.I. = 9/49 of Principal

The number of years = Rate of interest per annum

**Formula used:**

Simple interest = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100

**Calculation:**

Let Principal = P, Rate = Time = R

⇒ (9/49)P = (P × R × R)/100

⇒ R² = 900/49

⇒ R = √(900/49) = 30/7

**∴ The rate of interest is 30/7% p.a.**

questions.question: If the cost price of 20 articles is 5 times of the selling price of 4 articles, then what is the profit or loss percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of 20 articles = 5 × Selling price of 4 articles

**Calculation:**

⇒ 20 × Cost price of 1 article = 5 × 4 × Selling price of 1 article

⇒ Cost price of 1 article = Selling price of 1 article

∴ There is neither any profit nor any loss

questions.question: An item is sold at two successive discounts of 10% and 10%. The selling price of article after the two discount is Rs. 4050. If it is sold only at one discount of 20%, then what will be the selling price (in Rs) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discounts = 10%

**Formula used:**

Selling price = Marked price – Discount

**Calculation:**

⇒ 4050 = (100 – 10)% of (100 – 10)% of Marked price

⇒ 4050 = 0.9 × 0.9 × Marked price

⇒ Marked price = 4050/0.81 = Rs. 5000

At a single discount of 20%,

Selling price = (100 – 20)% of 5000 = 0.8 × 5000

∴ Selling price = Rs. 4000

questions.question: X and Y can do a piece of work in 10 days, Y and Z in 12 days and Z and X in 15 days. In how many days can Z alone do the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

No. of days X and Y take to complete a work = 10

No. of days Y and Z take to complete a work = 12

No. of days Z and X take to complete a work = 15

**Formula used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

(1 day work of X) + (1 day work of Y) = 1/10 ----(1)

(1 day work of Y) + (1 day work of Z) = 1/12 ----(2)

(1 day work of Z) + (1 day work of X) = 1/15 ----(3)

Adding (2) and (3), we get,

⇒ (1 day work of X) + (1 day work of Y) + 2(1 day work of Z) = 1/12 + 1/15 = 3/20

Substituting (1), we get,

⇒ 1/10 + 2(1 day work of Z) = 3/20

⇒ 2(1 day work of Z) = 3/20 – 1/10 = 1/20

⇒ 1 day work of Z = 1/(20 × 2) = 1/40

**∴ Z will alone do the work in 40 days**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Let the total work = LCM (10, 12, 15) = 60

Efficiency of X + Y = 60/10 = 6 units/day

Efficiency of Y + Z = 60/12 = 5 units/day

Efficiency of Z + X = 60/15 = 4 units/day

Efficiency of 2(X + Y + Z) = 15 units/day

So,Efficiency of (X + Y + Z) = 7.5 units/day

Now, Efficiency of Z = 7.5 - 6 = 1.5 units/day

Z alone do the work = 60/1.5 = 40 days

questions.question: The distance between places X and Y is 720 km. An express train leaves place X at 5:00 p.m. and runs at a speed of 45 km/hr. The train stops on the way for 45 minutes. At what time (in a.m.) will the train reach at place Y?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between = 720 km

**Calculation:**

Time taken by the train without stoppage = Distance/Speed = 720/45 = 16 hrs.

The train left X at 5:00 p.m., so without any stoppage, it will reach Y at 9:00 a.m.

∵ The train stops for 45 min,

∴ **It will reach Y at 9:45 a.m.**

questions.question: If the lengths of the two parallel sides of a trapezium are 5 cm and 7 cm and its area is 24 cm². Find the distance between its parallel sides (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two parallel sides of trapezium = 5 cm and 7 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of trapezium = [(sum of parallel sides) × (distance between parallel sides)]/2

**Calculation:**

⇒ 24 = [(5 + 7) × (distance between parallel sides)]/2

∴ Distance between parallel sides = (24 × 2)/12 = 4 cm

questions.question: If the measure of the interior angle of a regular polygon is 60° greater than the measure of its exterior angle then how many sides does it have?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The interior angle of a regular polygon - the measure of its exterior angle = 60°

**Concept used:**

For a regular polygon with n sides,

Interior angle = 180° – 360°/n

Exterior angle = 360°/n

**Calculation:**

⇒ 180° – 360°/n – 360°/n = 60°

⇒ 120° = 720°/n

⇒ n = 720°/120° = 6

**∴ The polygon has 6 sides**

questions.question: Find the total surface area (in cm²) of a right circular cone of diameter 24 cm and slant height 16 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter = 24 cm

Slant height = 16 cm

**Concept used:**

For a right circular cone with radius ‘r’ and slant height ‘l’,

Total surface area = πr(l + r)

**Calculation:**

Radius of given cone = 24/2 = 12 cm

∴ Total surface area of given cone = (22/7) × 12 × (12 + 16) = **1056 cm²**
